title: A small fix after the last review round gets one short read, then merges; the design reviewer runs beside code round 1
why: degen page item 83 (five degen PRs held about 2 hours), outbox late-review-fixes (7a87253a): rule roles-review-cap-three says nothing about a fix landed after round 3, and standing-merge-grant still needs a fresh reviewer on the merged head, so a lane that fixes its round-3 finding lands on a head no rule lets anyone read. Decision design-agents sets no place for the design reviewer against the code rounds.
note: Proposed (owner grant needed under outcomes-stale-decision-protocol): after the last round, a fix confined to that round's findings gets one fix check, a fresh Sonnet read of the fix diff and the finding only; pass merges on green, fail holds for the owner; a plain merge of main needs no read. Design reviewer runs beside code round 1 on the first built head (agents/design-reviewer.md, skills/design-review, decision design-agents). Open for the owner: does docs-only-prs-skip-review cover a record that files an owner ruling? Lane session_013NEJL2mkqxZo8g998PyeoS, started by the coordinator Nov 3 on an owner ask at 15:59 CST.
